serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
You: It’s time for us to leave. Did you pack everything?
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Yes…
You: What? Do you have second thoughts?
Bot: That’s the only place I’ve ever known. It feels weird leaving it forever.
You: I get it. I was the same when I was leaving my hometown, although back then I had many negative feelings about that place.
You: It’s going to pass. It’s too late to back down now. 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: I guess you are right! We need to press onward! It’s time for a new adventure!
